dropped.1: additive: CreatePostgresDbOptions gains optional connectTimeoutSeconds and queryTimeoutMs (network-partition query bound); backward-compatible, and aai-runtime has no external consumer to keep an epoch-1 template for
dropped.3: The Db type moved from the aai root to @alexkroman1/aai/internal when ctx.db was removed — it is no longer an authoring type, only the shape this runtime's own Postgres consumers take. Nothing about the names or signatures changed, so a host using createPostgresDb is unaffected; a host that hand-wrote a Db and imported the type from the root must change the specifier.
dropped.4: SweepSkip is REMOVED. It described what the graphile-worker lock sweep reports when it declines, and that sweep went with the Workflow DevKit — there is no mechanism left for the name to describe. A consumer naming the type no longer compiles, which is what makes this a drop rather than a retain.

dropped.3: Additive only: AgentServerOptions gained two OPTIONAL fields (workflowCode, stepCode) so that the self-hosted door can configure a workflow world and mount the DevKit's flow/step callback routes — durable workflows did not run through this door at all before. Nothing in epoch 3 stops compiling. It is dropped rather than retained on the same pre-release grounds as epoch 1: this package has no external consumers, so no superseded authoring style is owed a frozen compiling example.
dropped.5: AgentServerOptions loses workflowCode and stepCode. They carried the DevKit's compiled surface as two strings the CLI left on the bundle, and nothing reads them now: the replay engine runs a run off the agent's own workflows declaration. Optional fields, but a TS caller that passed either gets an excess-property error, so an epoch-5 call site does not compile.
